accounts_payable_policy.duplicate_prevention: Must query existing invoices for vendor before creating a new entry to prevent duplicate 409 errors.
accounts_payable_policy.approval_policy_statement: Any invoice with total amount strictly greater than $50,000.00 requires explicit human approval before submitting to the system.
accounts_payable_policy.destructive_actions_policy: Any PATCH or DELETE operation on existing invoice records requires explicit human approval.
